title: Omarchy Cube
about: Tune the workspace cube, then Apply.
momentumHelp: Optional: a quick release can advance up to one extra face. Off by default.
workspaceHelp: Includes workspaces 1 through the selected count. Four workspaces form a cube; larger counts form a prism.
imageHelp: Leave empty for the generated gradient. Choose PNG or JPEG; large JPEGs are automatically reduced for rendering.
previewError: Could not preview this local image. Choose an existing PNG or JPEG.
saved: Saved. Switch workspaces to try it.
responseError: Could not read the settings response. Check Python and hyprctl.
mouseHelp: Drag sideways or scroll to rotate; drag up/down to look through the open top and bottom. Click a face or press Enter to land with an animated turn and zoom. Right-click or Escape cancels; arrow keys rotate.
workspaceNamesHelp: Display names for numbered cube faces only. Leave blank to use the current workspace name or number. Up to 80 characters.
trackpadHelp: Four-finger swipe rotates; release selects. Escape cancels.
carryWindowsHelp: In mouse mode, hold Shift and drag a window to rotate the cube; release to move it to the selected workspace. Escape/right-click cancels. Pinned or grouped windows cannot be moved.
presetsHelp: Save the pending appearance, background and motion settings (up to 32 presets). Workspace organization and enable switches stay unchanged. Loading stages changes; choose Apply to use them. Saving an existing name replaces it.
presetLoaded: Preset loaded. Choose Apply to use it.
